notes: School district, modified cash basis (first year after dissolved-district merger; beginning balances are zero and the 4,968,148.15 'Cash balance from dissolved district' is printed in total receipts but shown as a Special Item on the Statement of Activities, so it is recorded in adjustments; reported receipts total ties via includes_split). Receipts, disbursements and ending cash use the Governmental Funds (total) column after reclassifications on Exhibit D (p5); labels come from the fund statement on p4. The reclassification column eliminates 127,044.91 of transfers (116,000 General Fund transfers out; 11,044.91 hidden inside the General Fund's Special education 0-5 program lines, transferred to the Cooperative Fund), so no transfers appear at the total level and transfers_in/out are null. 'Taxes: Other' 1,376,314.65 (p5) is split into property tax credit 1,330,183.74, homestead 26,476.85, pro-rate 8,913.97 and nameplate 10,740.09 using the General Fund (Exh. G p8: 1,353,519.45) and QCPU (Exh. M p16: 22,795.20) breakdowns. 'Other local receipts' 520,821.76 is split using the fund schedules: General Fund lines (Exh. G p8, 58,268.81), Student Fee Fund 14,828.24, School Nutrition sales 102,635.65, Cooperative 'Received from other districts' 117,912.69, QCPU miscellaneous 162.04 and the Activity Fund 227,014.33 (new Exhibit J, p13, whose receipts total 424,691.77 less the 36,000 General Fund transfer and 161,677.44 of dissolved-district cash; the latter derived by subtraction from p5 and Exhibits K and M). County receipts split into county fines 12,600.78 and ESU receipts 4,379.21 (Exh. G). 'Other student support' 513,679.23 (p5) is now split into School Nutrition 255,826.49 (Exh. K), Activity Fund 243,024.50 (Exh. J) and Student Fee Fund 14,828.24 (Exh. O); the Activity Fund is the previously missing student activities schedule (Exhibit J gives account groups, not individual accounts). Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position (p1); fund balance sheet on p3 not used. Detail: Exhibit G (General Fund budgetary comparison receipts, plus the 8000 Transfers line) plus Exhibits H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O. For General Fund expenditures, the object-level Exhibit P (Cash Disbursements for Operational Expenses - General Fund, pp19-25, complete through Transfers and Total Cash Disbursements 5,254,317.95 on p25) replaces every program line of Exhibit G, so nothing is double counted; Exhibit G's 8000 Transfers line (-116,000; budget -60,000; Exhibit P p25 shows School Nutrition 80,000 and Activity Fund 36,000) and the two hidden-transfer contra/other-financing pairs stay under Exhibit G, whose expenditure total (p10) counts the Exhibit P lines via includes_schedules. The General Fund Components combining schedule (pp6-7) duplicates those lines and was not recorded. The 275,000 allocation to the Depreciation Fund is embedded in student transportation - regular (Exhibit F reclassification, p7); Exhibit P shows it as Vehicle Operation Capital Assets 275,000.00 (p24), kept as printed with a contra expenditure line and an other-financing line; likewise the 11,044.91 General Fund to Cooperative Fund transfer inside the Special education 0-5 lines has a contra expenditure line and an other-financing line (Exhibit D p5, Cooperative Fund p17). The Activity Fund receipts (Exhibit J) include a 36,000 General Fund transfer and 161,677.44 of dissolved-district cash, handled with one contra revenue line plus two other-financing lines. Dissolved-district cash lines in the fund schedules are section 'other financing' (not revenue, matching the top-level adjustment); the schedules' revenue totals mark includes other financing. Budget amounts of '-' recorded as 0 on Exhibit G; other fund schedules print only total budgets, so budget_final is null there. Activity Fund budget (378,646 receipts and disbursements) is a one-line total and not carried. Read pages 1-25 of 25
